periodicity_terms.status: PROTOTYPE - illustrative vocabulary, not an official PRGI list.
periodicity_terms.notes: Single-token vocabulary of common periodicity words, used only as a fallback signal. The rule layer also checks each candidate's own actual Periodicity field directly, since PRGI periodicity values are free text (e.g. 'Daily (Evening)', 'Twice a week') and cannot be reduced to a fixed enum. Tokens here are split the same way normalize_title/tokenize_title split real periodicity text, so e.g. 'half-yearly' is represented as 'half' and 'yearly'.

generic_components.status: PROTOTYPE - starter list from the PSS06 problem statement's own examples only.
generic_components.notes: Reporting-only: presence/addition/removal of these components is returned as evidence, not treated as a violation by this layer. Extend as needed.

disallowed_words.status: PROTOTYPE_PLACEHOLDER - NOT the official PRGI disallowed-word list. The actual PRGI guideline list was not available in this repository. These entries are illustrative only (a common category of restriction across many countries' title/name-registration rules: words implying government, law-enforcement, or official state affiliation) and must be replaced with PRGI's real list before this evidence is used for anything beyond prototype demonstration.
